name: Voice2net Telecom Group
summary: Telco group (voice2net.com.au); absorbed FutureWeb Mar 2015 (own notice), then itself rebranded Q Telecom within the same month; the group later sat under parent Powercom Pacific (2021) and the brand line continues as More Telecom (more.com.au, from 2023).

events.details: FutureWeb announced "FutureWeb is now part of the Voice2net Telecom Group" (13 Mar 2015 capture); Voice2net rebranded to Q Telecom by 20 Mar 2015.

refs.label: FutureWeb notice (Mar 2015): 'now part of the Voice2net Telecom Group'

events.details: Group brand line now More Telecom (futureweb.com.au 301s to more.com.au by May 2023); Powercom Pacific became group parent 2021.
